cohort: 48 pregnant women with epilepsy (WWE) treated at a regional tertiary epilepsy center
finding: In women with epilepsy, epilepsy classification, number of AEDs taken, and frequency of seizures were not significantly correlated with delivery method or fetal condition.
mod_finding: This study found no significant correlation between epilepsy classification, number of antiepileptic drugs taken, seizure frequency, and mode of delivery or fetal condition in women with epilepsy.
